verdict.rationale: Polar documents recurring subscriptions that auto-renew each billing period and create new orders (polar-docs-10). Proration behavior is configurable at the organization level or per API call (polar-docs-12), seats prorate automatically (polar-docs-28), and failed renewals go through automated dunning (polar-supp-dunning). Upgrades are only implied by the proration docs, and nothing in the pack mentions free trials or how plan tiers are defined. Missing for 10: documented free trials, explicit upgrade/downgrade plan-change docs, plan/tier configuration details, independent hands-on corroboration.
